claim.statement: LLM trade quality scoring/gating requires held-out evaluation data that is not used for training, prompt selection, fine-tuning, or threshold calibration.
claim.evidence_summary: scikit-learn cross-validation docs and OpenAI fine-tuning guidance both support separate evaluation data for reliable assessment.
claim.interpretation_notes: This candidate is scoped to AI Engineering governance for LLM trade quality scoring/gating systems. It does not define trading signals, order execution rules, or strategy parameters.

applies_when: Building or auditing LLM training, RAG, MCP, evaluation, or governance for trade quality scoring/gating assistants.
not_applicable_when: The task asks for concrete trading entries, exits, position sizing, account-specific settings, or live order execution.
assumptions: External projects provide project facts and private data; CEK-TA stores only generalized reusable knowledge.
limitations: Candidate requires human or AI audit before conversion to formal reviewed knowledge.

source_refs.evidence_summary: scikit-learn documents evaluation with held-out data and warns against repeated test-set tuning.
OpenAI fine-tuning guidance distinguishes training and test/eval data and emphasizes data quality for model improvement.

limitations: Sources support the engineering boundary; final formal knowledge should add CEK-TA-specific examples and conflict links.

audit_log.reason: Phase 36 first P0-Core AI Engineering collection batch.

方向充分成立。LLM trade quality scoring/gating 需要 holdout test/eval set，且该 set 不得用于训练、prompt selection、fine-tuning、threshold calibration 或其他会污染最终评估的过程。scikit-learn 和 OpenAI fine-tuning best practices 均直接支持训练/评估数据分离和 held-out evaluation。

ai_audit.reason: 方向充分成立。LLM trade quality scoring/gating 需要 holdout test/eval set，且该 set 不得用于训练、prompt selection、fine-tuning、threshold calibration 或其他会污染最终评估的过程。scikit-learn 和 OpenAI fine-tuning best practices 均直接支持训练/评估数据分离和 held-out evaluation。
source_patch_notes: 保留 scikit-learn cross-validation 作为 held-out evaluation 和 repeated test-set tuning 风险来源。
保留 OpenAI fine-tuning best practices 作为 training/test examples 拆分和用 test set 评估模型的来源，但注明 fine-tuning platform 相关页面存在迁移 / winding down freshness 风险。
补 scikit-learn common pitfalls / data leakage 作为 test data 不得参与 fit / preprocessing / tuning 的来源。
content_patch_notes: 正式 statement 建议写为：Holdout test/eval data for LLM gate/scoring must not be used for training, prompt selection, fine-tuning, DPO selection, threshold calibration, RAG index construction or model selection.
增加污染动作：如果 holdout 被用于调 prompt、调阈值或选择模型版本，则必须废弃该版本或降级为 validation set，并创建新 holdout。
明确 validation set 与 final holdout set 角色不同。
boundary_patch_notes: AI Engineering 管理 holdout set 的用途限制、hash、版本和污染检测。
原始交易样本、账户数据和策略细节保留在项目私有数据域，只在 AI Engineering 中记录引用和脱敏摘要。
与交易收益口径相关的评估由 Trading Engineering 提供或审核。
conflict_patch_notes: 与 eval_case.no_training_overlap_required 正向重叠：本条是 holdout policy，后者是 eval case overlap check。
